 Greta Cross USA TODAY Updated Nov. 9, 2026, 11:55 a.m. ET Hear this story Cardi B , Travis Scott and Metro Boomin are set to headline a music festival for the release of GTA 6 later this month.
 On Nov. 9, Rockstar Games announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival , a single-day music festival in Miami to celebrate the highly-anticipated video game's release. Tickets for the festival are available later this week via a lottery.
 After 13 years since the last GTA release, GTA 6 hits shelves (online stores and consoles) on Thursday, Nov. 19.
 Here's what to know about Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival.
 It's getting closer: GTA 6 to start preloading onto consoles Tuesday USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. Who is headlining the GTA 6 music festival?
 Here's a look at the musicians performing at Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival:
 Travis Scott
 Cardi B
 Don Toliver
 Kodak Black
 Sofaygo
 CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso
 Justice (DJ set)
 Metro Boomin
 Nick Leon back-to-back DJ Python
 Prospa back-to-back Skream
 Rauw & Friends
 Suero
 Tainy
 The Dare back-to-back Fcukers (DJ set)
 Where is the GTA 6 music festival?
 The music festival is at Mana Wynwood Convention Center in Miami.
 How to get tickets to GTA 6 music festival
 Tickets for the GTA 6 music festival are available via lottery. Here's how to apply:
 Sign up for the ticket lottery at gtavi-thefestival.miami by 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Nov. 10.
 Winners will be randomly selected at 7 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Nov. 10.
 Tickets go on sale for lottery winners at noon ET on Wednesday, Nov. 11. Winners are limited to two tickets per purchase.
 The lottery and ticket sales are managed by ticketing platform DICE. Those interested in entering the lottery are encouraged to create a DICE account after entering the lottery to avoid being flagged as a bot, the Rockstar website states.

You can win it New GTA 6 trailer gives fans another look at gaming's biggest release What to know about GTA 6 release
 Set in Leonida − the franchise's take on Florida − GTA 6 can be played through protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, inspired by Bonnie and Clyde. The game releases on Nov. 19 but is available for preorder through release day.
 On Nov. 3, Rockstar announced that the preordered game would begin downloading on PlayStation and XBOX consoles on Tuesday, Nov. 10 . The preload begins more than a week before the game can be accessed and played due to its large file size. The game preload requires up to 212 gigabytes, depending on the console.
 How much does the GTA 6 preorder cost?
 Here's how much GTA 6 costs per edition :
 Standard edition: $79.99 (available at PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S digital codes and physical download code in a box)
 Ultimate edition: $99.99 (available at PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S digital codes)
